response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), sh AS (SELECT st, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), av AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM av WHERE share > avg_share
